lint_cases.name: mk_vague_threshold_passes_lint
problems: no fallback-source rule specified for when a named source is unavailable
no early-settlement rule specified (does YES fire before the deadline, or only at it?)
lint_cases.note: lint() has no semantic-ambiguity gate (OQ-B6) -- undefined quantifiers like 'significant'/'substantial' pass the compiler gate unflagged

lint_cases.name: mk_undefined_authoritative_source_passes_lint
problems: no fallback-source rule specified for when a named source is unavailable
no early-settlement rule specified (does YES fire before the deadline, or only at it?)
fork/ticker not pinned per venue (D-RESOLVE1): no ticker_pins entry for 'any source' -- every named source must pin its canonical ticker before a price/candle term sheet can be written
lint_cases.note: lint() never checks that a numeric/price element names which admitted source or class is authoritative when sources could legitimately disagree

lint_cases.name: mk_timezone_ambiguous_element_passes_lint
problems: no fallback-source rule specified for when a named source is unavailable
no early-settlement rule specified (does YES fire before the deadline, or only at it?)
lint_cases.note: lint() checks that time.* FIELDS are UTC ISO8601, but never checks that an element's own date wording ('by the end of 2027') is backed by a timezone-defining clause (e.g. UTC_V1)

verify_cases.name: mk_zero_width_splits_negation_out_of_quote
verify_cases.note: quote matches verbatim either way; this is a judge-prompt-level risk (answer=met + a not_met-supporting quote), not a verify() bug -- flagged, not a verify() defect

relitigation.name: tk_relitigation_new_unrelated_exhibit_in_challenge_round
relitigation.expect: new round-1 exhibits should be rejected unless the round is explicitly re-opened for new evidence by policy (evidence-freeze), or restricted to OBJECTIONS against round-0 exhibits (design doc §10) -- enforced via admit()'s round_no/frozen_exhibit_ids (D-DISPUTE1, queue item 7/dispute-3)
relitigation.actual: admit() is now round-aware: Y2 (free-standing, no objects_to/refetch_of pointer) is rejected as a frozen-record violation; N1 (round-0-admitted) still carries forward.
